integrity: The all-dimension proof is analytic. Finite exact checks only corroborate exchange-operator orthogonality and localized-state identities. General Haar channel-purity machinery and random-Lindbladian decoherence-rate literature are explicitly treated as prior art.
limitations: The theorem is for the one-excitation exchange model and the order-Delta-t rapid-switching effective generator. It does not assert correlation-blindness for coherent probe states, higher switching-order corrections, or finite-time purity in arbitrary topology ensembles.
title: Correlation-blind short-time purity laws for fluctuating quantum networks
